text:
The plate is square, about 24–26 cm across, and holds three small mounds of fried or toasted rice. Each mound is roughly 8×7 cm and loosely piled. Together they look like about 1 cup of cooked rice, around 150 g. Because the rice appears browned in oil, I estimated roughly 1.6–1.8 kcal per gram, which gives about 260 kcal.
